tasks.short: Train production personnel in new or existing methods.

steps.what: Train production personnel in existing methods
Sign the method version that was taught

outputs: filed copy of signed training note v1

tasks.design: Training stays in person. The engineer signs the method version that was taught, in {LMS}, and a job files that note. The note is not a score of a person, and a job does not decide who passed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The method version taught was often missing from the attendance note.
tasks.enabler_now: The learning record can store a signed note.
tasks.still_hard: People still have to be shown the method.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what was taught and whether the group is ready to try it.
tasks.altitude: Teaching time does not shrink. Filing the signed method version moves.

reach.task: Confirm the crew uses the signed method version

evidence.claim: Digest [S18] bars a solely automated decision about a worker, so a decision about a person stays with the engineer.
The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.

assumptions: The note records the method version, not a person's score.
Configure the learning record before a new tool.
unknowns: Whether attendance is a personnel record.
research_questions: Whether a local rule treats the roster as worker monitoring.

already_counted.description: Training on the floor stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design tests of finished products and process capabilities.

steps.what: Design tests of finished products and process capabilities
Fill the test sheet from the standard table
Set standards that validate process requirements

outputs: filed copy of signed test design v1

tasks.design: The engineer designs the tests. A job fills the sheet in {DOCS} from the standard table the engineer named. The engineer sets the standards that validate the process requirements, signs the design, and a job files that version. A later passing result is not proof by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test sheets were copied forward, and the standard version was easy to lose.
tasks.enabler_now: The standard table can fill a sheet without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what the test must prove is still a design judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sets the standard and the sample the test will use.

ambition.what: Issue a new test sheet when the standard table version changes.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on what the test must prove.

reach.learn: Which standard version the design froze

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: The sheet copies the standard table and does not invent a limit.
Configure the document store before a new tool.
unknowns: Which standard applies to this product.
Who else must sign a test used for release.
research_questions: How often the standard table and the lab method disagree.

already_counted.description: Designing the test stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.short: Analyze financial impacts of sustainable manufacturing processes.

steps.what: Analyze financial impacts of sustainable manufacturing processes
Multiply recorded usage by the factor and price tables
Judge which impacts belong in the note

outputs: filed copy of signed impact note v1

tasks.design: A job multiplies recorded usage by the firm's factor and price tables in {SPREADSHEET}. Energy figures come from meter records. The engineer analyzes the financial impact, signs the note in {DOCS}, and a job files that version. A model does not invent a factor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Impacts were estimated from memory, and energy figures were not tied to a meter.
tasks.enabler_now: Usage, factors, and prices can be multiplied by a fixed rule.
tasks.still_hard: A factor table can be wrong for this site even when the arithmetic is right.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides which impacts are real for this process.

ambition.what: Recompute the impact when a meter period closes, before the note is signed again.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the analysis on what the numbers mean.

reach.task: Use the signed impact in the cost review
reach.learn: Which meter period and factor version were used

evidence.claim: Digest [S17] describes an energy information duty every four years and a research duty above a site threshold, so energy use in this note comes from meter records.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: Factors come from the firm's table, not from a model.
Energy use comes from meter records.
unknowns: Whether this site is above the energy research threshold.
research_questions: How often meter data arrives after the review date.

already_counted.description: Analyzing the impacts stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop sustainable technologies that cut emissions, toxic materials, or waste.

steps.what: Develop sustainable manufacturing technologies for the product
Sum material and waste quantities from bill and scrap
Choose renewable materials or replace toxic materials

outputs: filed copy of signed development note v1

tasks.design: Development stays with the engineer. A job sums material and waste from the bill and scrap in {ERP}. The engineer chooses renewable materials or a replacement for toxic materials, signs the note in {DOCS}, and a job files that version. No emission figure is invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material totals were rebuilt for every idea, and a claimed saving had no bill behind it.
tasks.enabler_now: The bill and the scrap record can be summed by a fixed rule.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a substitute works in this process is not in the bill.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer develops the option and chooses the material.

ambition.what: Offer a signed material option with the current bill totals attached.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the technology, not on summing the bill.

reach.task: Source the material named in the signed note
reach.learn: Which bill version the totals used

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: Totals come from the bill and scrap rows.
Configure those records before a new store.
unknowns: Which materials are classed as toxic here.
Who must sign a material change.
research_questions: Whether a substitute is already qualified.

already_counted.description: Developing the technology stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

role.altitude: The manufacturing engineer spends the week on cause, design, and the signed decision. Collecting rows and filing a signed note move to a job.
reach: Quality technicians get a field list for the part they collect, instead of a blank request.
Planners wait for the signed note before they move a routing.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no source row.
Release only the version they signed, and leave a safety function to a person.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change note can open a controlled routing update, and the engineer still releases it.
